track.name: sql-analytics
track.label: SQL for Business Analysts
track.summary: Master SQL from first queries to window functions and real-world business reporting — learn to query databases, combine tables, aggregate data, and write the analyses that drive data-driven decisions.

phases.title: SQL Foundations
phases.description: Write your first real queries — SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, GROUP BY, and HAVING — and understand why SQL beats spreadsheets for large datasets.

phases.title: Joins & Relationships
phases.description: Combine data across multiple tables using INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, and FULL JOINs, and learn to read entity-relationship diagrams so you know which tables to join.

phases.title: Aggregations & Window Functions
phases.description: Go beyond GROUP BY — partition aggregates, rank rows, and compute LEAD/LAG differences and running totals without collapsing your result set.

phases.title: CTEs & Subqueries
phases.description: Break complex queries into readable building blocks using WITH clauses, nested SELECTs, and query decomposition techniques that make code easier to review and maintain.

phases.title: Real Business Queries
phases.description: Apply SQL to the reports analysts actually produce — cohort analysis, funnel drop-off, churn, retention, and revenue breakdowns.

phases.title: BigQuery & Cloud SQL
phases.description: Move from local practice to the cloud — spin up BigQuery's free sandbox, explore public datasets, and learn to write cost-efficient queries.

topics.title: SELECT, WHERE, and ORDER BY
topics.description: Write your first queries — choose columns with SELECT, filter rows with WHERE, and sort results with ORDER BY.

topics.title: GROUP BY, HAVING, and Aggregate Functions
topics.description: Summarise datasets with COUNT, SUM, and AVG, group them with GROUP BY, and filter groups with the HAVING clause.

topics.title: Databases vs. Spreadsheets
topics.description: Understand when SQL beats Excel — relational structure, millions of rows, reproducibility, and the limits of each tool.

topics.title: INNER JOIN and LEFT JOIN
topics.description: Combine rows from two tables on a shared key using INNER JOIN (matched rows only) and LEFT JOIN (all left-table rows).

topics.title: RIGHT, FULL, and Multi-Table JOINs
topics.description: Complete the JOIN family with RIGHT and FULL OUTER JOINs, then chain multiple JOINs to pull data from three or more tables at once.

topics.title: Entity-Relationship Diagrams (ERDs)
topics.description: Read an ERD to identify primary and foreign keys, understand one-to-many relationships, and plan which tables to join before writing a single line of SQL.

topics.title: Partitioned Aggregations with OVER
topics.description: Use the OVER clause with PARTITION BY to compute SUM, COUNT, and AVG per group without collapsing rows the way GROUP BY does.

topics.title: RANK, ROW_NUMBER, and DENSE_RANK
topics.description: Assign ordinal positions to rows within a partition — rank customers by spend, flag the top-N records per group, and understand the difference between RANK and DENSE_RANK.

topics.title: LEAD, LAG, and Running Totals
topics.description: Compare a row to the previous or next row with LAG and LEAD, and build running totals and moving averages with ordered window frames.

topics.title: Common Table Expressions (CTEs) with WITH
topics.description: Define named result sets using WITH clauses so each logical step of a complex query can be read and tested independently.

topics.title: Subqueries and Nested SELECT Statements
topics.description: Embed a SELECT inside another SELECT to filter on aggregated results, create derived tables, and solve problems that a single flat query cannot handle.

topics.title: Query Decomposition and Readability
topics.description: Refactor long one-liner queries into layered CTEs, add meaningful aliases, and apply formatting conventions that make SQL reviews fast.

topics.title: Cohort Analysis and Funnel Queries
topics.description: Group users by acquisition week, track how they move through a funnel, and compute conversion rates at each step using window functions and CTEs.

topics.title: Churn and Retention Analysis
topics.description: Detect users who became inactive, compute monthly retention rates, and investigate the causes of an engagement drop with SQL case studies.

topics.title: Revenue Reporting and Business Metrics
topics.description: Write MRR and ARR roll-forward queries, segment revenue by product or region, and validate A/B test results directly in SQL.

topics.title: Google BigQuery Free Tier Setup
topics.description: Activate BigQuery's sandbox, query Google's free public datasets, and understand the 1 TB/month free query allowance so you can practise at no cost.

topics.title: Snowflake Trial and Cloud SQL Basics
topics.description: Set up a Snowflake 30-day trial, load sample data, and compare syntax differences between BigQuery standard SQL and Snowflake SQL.

topics.title: Query Cost Optimisation
topics.description: Read query execution plans, use columnar partitioning and clustering, avoid SELECT *, and estimate byte costs before running expensive scans.

resources.title: W3Schools SQL Tutorial
resources.note: Interactive reference covering SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, and every core SQL clause — try every example in the browser.

resources.title: SQLZoo SELECT Basics
resources.note: Free in-browser exercises that test SELECT, WHERE, and comparisons on a world countries dataset — graded difficulty.

resources.title: SQL GROUP BY Statement — W3Schools
resources.note: Clear explanation of GROUP BY with COUNT and SUM examples — includes a live editor to experiment with the syntax.

resources.title: SQL HAVING Clause — W3Schools
resources.note: Shows why HAVING is needed after GROUP BY and WHERE cannot be used on aggregate values — includes worked examples.

resources.title: Introduction to SQL — Mode Analytics Tutorial
resources.note: Mode's free SQL school opens with a plain-English case for why analysts use SQL instead of spreadsheets — written for Excel users switching to databases.

resources.title: Intro to SQL — Kaggle Learn
resources.note: Free 3-hour course using BigQuery datasets — earns a Kaggle certificate and walks through SELECT, GROUP BY, and ORDER BY on real data.

resources.title: Your Complete Guide to SQL JOINs
resources.note: Comprehensive free guide covering every JOIN type with visual diagrams — bookmark this as a reference for multi-table work.

resources.title: SQL JOIN — W3Schools
resources.note: Quick interactive reference for INNER JOIN syntax with a try-it editor — useful for checking syntax while writing queries.

resources.title: SQL JOIN Types Explained
resources.note: Contrasts INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, and FULL OUTER JOINs with Venn diagrams and side-by-side result sets so the differences click quickly.

resources.title: SQLZoo — The JOIN Operation
resources.note: Hands-on exercises combining three tables (game, goal, eteam) — graded questions push you from basic to multi-condition JOINs.

resources.title: PostgreSQL Exercises
resources.note: Seven exercise sets on a single club dataset — the Joins section specifically builds multi-table intuition through 13 progressively harder problems.

resources.title: SQL JOINs for Beginners
resources.note: Plain-language walkthrough of how primary and foreign keys link tables — helps you read an ERD and translate it into a JOIN condition.

resources.title: SQL Window Functions — Mode Advanced SQL
resources.note: Mode's definitive free guide to window functions — covers OVER, PARTITION BY, and aggregate window functions with real analyst datasets.

resources.title: SQL Window Functions Reference — W3Schools
resources.note: Concise reference listing every window function with syntax examples you can run — good as a quick lookup while practising.

resources.title: SQL RANK, DENSE_RANK, ROW_NUMBER Explained
resources.note: Side-by-side comparison showing exactly when RANK and DENSE_RANK produce different results — includes interview-style practice problems.

resources.title: PostgreSQL Exercises — Aggregates
resources.note: The Aggregates section of PGExercises includes ranked and window-function problems — run queries live in the browser with instant feedback.

resources.title: SQL LEAD and LAG Functions Tutorial
resources.note: Practical guide to LEAD and LAG with worked examples calculating period-over-period changes — exactly the pattern used in retention reporting.

resources.title: Advanced SQL — Kaggle Learn
resources.note: Free 4-hour Kaggle course covering analytic (window) functions, nested data, and efficient BigQuery patterns — earns a certificate.

resources.title: SQL CTE (Common Table Expressions) — W3Schools
resources.note: Short, clear introduction to WITH clause syntax with runnable examples — a good starting point before writing multi-step CTEs.

resources.title: SQL WITH AS — Mode Advanced SQL
resources.note: Mode's CTE tutorial walks through refactoring a nested query into a chain of named WITH clauses on analyst-style data.

resources.title: SQL Subqueries — Mode Advanced SQL
resources.note: Covers correlated and uncorrelated subqueries, WHERE IN patterns, and when to choose a subquery over a CTE.

resources.title: SQLZoo — SELECT within SELECT
resources.note: Interactive exercises that require embedding a SELECT in the WHERE clause — builds the mental model for correlated subqueries.

resources.title: PostgreSQL Exercises — Full Exercise Set
resources.note: Working through PGExercises in order — Joins, Aggregates, Dates — develops the query decomposition habit naturally as problems grow more complex.

resources.title: SQL Tutorial Full Reference — W3Schools
resources.note: Use the W3Schools left-nav as a checklist of every SQL clause — useful for auditing gaps in your query-writing vocabulary.

resources.title: Cohort Analysis — Mode SQL Analytics Training
resources.note: Step-by-step cohort analysis case study using real engagement data — shows how to group users by sign-up week and track them across time.

resources.title: Advanced SQL — Kaggle Learn
resources.note: The analytic functions module covers running totals and cohort-style calculations on BigQuery datasets — hands-on with real data.

resources.title: Investigating a Drop in User Engagement
resources.note: A realistic case study where you diagnose a sudden dip in weekly active users — the exact type of churn/retention analysis analysts face.

resources.title: SQL Window Functions — Mode Advanced SQL
resources.note: Window function patterns for computing 7-day rolling averages and week-over-week retention rates — used in the drop-in-engagement case study.

resources.title: Validating A/B Test Results with SQL
resources.note: Revenue-focused case study that validates experiment results in SQL — shows how analysts check statistical significance and segment revenue impact.

resources.title: Introduction to SQL — Mode Analytics Tutorial
resources.note: The full Mode SQL school curriculum links every business query pattern in one place — good as a structured revision path after phase 5.

resources.title: How to Use Google BigQuery to Practice SQL for Free

resources.title: Advanced SQL — Kaggle Learn (BigQuery)
resources.note: All Kaggle SQL exercises run on BigQuery — the nested data and writing efficient queries modules introduce cloud-specific features and cost patterns.

resources.title: BigQuery Tutorial for Beginners — DataCamp
